PAT DRISCOLL has been posted as missing with his fighter ten days after D-day-and REG SHEPHERD is still amongst the missing. BERT FOOTER has been right up in the front at Normandy and would welcome a rest in the rear.
Reg Shepherd, back from Canada with his ``wings'' is now in Scotland. (News has just been received that Reg has been posted missing after a reconaissance over Europe).
